provenance_note: The reference corpus was authored by another agent from the public specification of this tool and the cited standards, without access to this code; this run recomputes every check from the shipping build.
reference: Hand-built load-list states in the tool-neutral vocabulary of SPEC-loadlist §13: the four spec presets (pumping station with generator-backed board, three-level commercial board tree with single-phase circuits, UPS data room, undersized generator), a trigger case and a near-miss for every rule LOA-R-001…047 (reserved 027-029/048-049 never expected), boundary cases at the spec's stated equality points (source and UPS loading exactly 1.0, loading exactly 0.8, lf exactly 1.0 and 1.5, start step equal to its limit, voltage deviation exactly 2 %, k_LR 1 and 12, U 36 000 V, P 1e8 W, n_out 1/2/3/4/5/6/9/10), supply-boundary and UPS propagation, motor-start region and candidate selection, handoff for load and board, and package-dependent rules. Every expected number is recomputed by loadlist-ref.py, an own stdlib implementation of SPEC §4 written from the spec text; the script also reproduces 62 of the 63 figures the spec quotes in §4.8 and §9 to the printed digits and all four preset finding sets and verdicts; the one exception is a last-digit rounding slip in §9.1 (TX1 S_st printed 476 249.382 VA, exact value 476 249.3815 VA). Diversity defaults follow IEC 61439-2:2020 Table 101 Distribution rows (0.9/0.8/0.7/0.6), confirmed against the BEAMA verification guide transcription; all other defaults and thresholds are the spec's author method.

TZ-project-package.md §2.2-§2.3 and TZ-engineering-workflow.md §3 - structure, flags, calculations shape used in package cases
tolerance: Categorical outputs (verdict, finding set, counts, ids, motor ids, n_out, k_used, register ids/kinds, units) are exact; findings are compared as a set of (rule, target, cases) with cases in the fixed order normal, peak, startup, emergency, maintenance. Numbers: relative 1e-9, absolute 1e-6 in SI units where the reference is 0 ('abs_if_zero'). Basis: every number is a closed form of at most a few hundred double operations (sum, product, sqrt, tan(acos)), so accumulated rounding is below 1e-13 relative and a 1e-9 band cannot hide a formula or summation-scope defect (the smallest formula difference exercised, e.g. P/η vs P for a UPS child with η 0.95, is 5e-2 relative). Boundary cases are built from exactly representable inputs so the equality holds bit-exactly (loading 100 000/100 000, 80 000/100 000, step 5·10 000/100 000, deviation 408−400 vs 0.02·400 = 8.0) and their outcome is fixed by the spec's 'strictly greater' wording. A null reference means null or absent.
flagged_note: Cases the corpus itself marks disputable: the specification admits more than one reading of the target set and the reference states which reading it took. They are counted as passed and listed here so the reading is not buried.
